g.text: Workflow 4 — Recruiter Team Invitation, Granular RBAC & Tenant Isolation
Invitation Request → Scope Validation → 32-Byte Token & SHA-256 Hash → ZeptoMail Dispatch → Token Acceptance → Membership Activation → 28-Permission Matrix
EXECUTION PIPELINE: 8 SEQUENTIAL STAGES FROM INVITATION DISPATCH TO RBAC ENFORCEMENT
Raw token NEVER stored in MongoDB
If network fails, marks status: FAILED
Admin can view error & click resend
Injected on all subsequent DB queries
Session stores user ID + company ID
1. TEAM MANAGEMENT APIS, INVITATION RESEND & REVOKE
• Auth Guard: Enforces active company recruiter session via ServerAuth
Fields: { email, name, role, title, department, assignedJobIds?: string[], interviewTypes?: string[] }
• Input Payload: { token: string } (Raw 32-byte hexadecimal token)
• Hash Evaluation: Computes sha256(token) and queries db.companyInvitation
• Idempotent Acceptance: If already accepted, safely returns active membership record
• Revocation Check: Throws HTTP 403 if invitation was revoked by company administrator
• Account Elevation: Auto-provisions User (role: RECRUITER) + db.companyMember
Generates fresh 32-byte token, resets 7-day expiration, updates lastSentAt, dispatches new email.
Sets status = 'REVOKED', records revokedAt. Immediately invalidates any in-flight email links.
• Company ID Binding: All queries inject where: { companyId: auth.company.id }. Zero leakage.
• Invitee Multi-Tenancy: A user can belong to multiple companies via distinct CompanyMember rows.
• Audit Compliance: Every team modification logs actorId, companyId, and previous/new roles.
• Admin Lockout Protection: The system prevents removing the last active COMPANY_ADMIN.
Permissions (All 28): team:view, team:invite, team:manage_roles, team:remove_member, company:view, company:manage,
jobs:view, jobs:create, jobs:edit, jobs:publish, jobs:close, applications:view_all, applications:view_assigned,
candidates:view_all, pipeline:transition, interviews:*, offers:*, assessments:*, reports:view, dashboard:view
Permissions (23): jobs:create, jobs:edit, jobs:publish, jobs:close, applications:view_all, pipeline:transition,
interviews:view_all, interviews:schedule, interviews:assign, interviews:feedback_*, assessments:*, dashboard:view
RESTRICTIONS: Lacks team management (team:invite, team:manage_roles) and company settings modification
interviews:view_assigned, interviews:feedback_*, offers:view, offers:manage, reports:view, dashboard:view
STRICT SCOPING: Injects where: { id: { in: auth.membership.assignedJobIds } }. Only sees their assigned roles.
Permissions (7): interviews:view_all, interviews:schedule, interviews:assign, candidates:view_all, applications:view_all, jobs:view
RESTRICTIONS: Read-only access to applications/jobs; cannot submit technical/HR interview feedback scorecards.
STRICT SCOPING: Injects where: { interviewerId: auth.user.id }. Cannot view other interview rounds.
Summary of the 28 Granular RBAC Permissions:
Team (4): team:view, team:invite, team:manage_roles, team:remove_member | Company (2): company:view, company:manage
Jobs (5): jobs:view, jobs:create, jobs:edit, jobs:publish, jobs:close | Applications (2): applications:view_all, applications:view_assigned
Interviews (6): view_all, view_assigned, schedule, assign, feedback_tech, feedback_hr | Offers (2) | Assessments (2) | Reports (1) | Dashboard (1)
3. PERSISTENCE MODELS, SHA-256 TOKENS & EMAIL DISPATCH
assignedJobIds String[] (Array of job IDs for Hiring Managers)
interviewTypes String[] (Array of interview types for interviewers)
tokenHash String (SHA-256 hex digest of the 32-byte raw token)
Raw token is NEVER saved in MongoDB. Even database administrators cannot hijack invitation tokens.
status InvitationStatus (Enum: PENDING, ACCEPTED, REVOKED, EXPIRED, FAILED)
expiresAt DateTime (Set to exactly now + 7 days)
COMPOUND UNIQUE CONSTRAINT: @@unique([companyId, userId]) — Prevents duplicate active memberships
• REST Provider: Dispatches via https://api.zeptomail.in/v1.1/email with Bearer API Key.
• Template Payload: Displays company name, inviter name, role description, and personalized accept button.
• 7-Day Expiration Notice: Template warns user that the cryptographic link expires in 7 days.
• Delivery Status Logging: Emits RECRUITER_INVITATION_CREATED event with deliveryId in db.emailDelivery.
Prisma Models: CompanyInvitation · CompanyMember · User · RecruiterProfile · AuditLog
✓ 6 Roles Verified · 28 Permissions Matrix · 7-Day SHA-256 Token · Strict Multi-Tenant Isolation
